photoTips.title: Tips for a clear photo
photoTips.close: Get close, so the insect fills a good part of the photo.
photoTips.focus: Tap the insect on your screen to bring it into focus.
photoTips.light: Use soft daylight. Avoid harsh shadows and flash glare.
photoTips.single: Photograph one insect at a time, if you can.
photoTips.background: A plain background, like a leaf or a sheet of paper, helps.

landing.title: A field notebook for the insects on your plants
landing.headline: A field notebook for the insects on your plants.
landing.intro: Photograph an insect when you find it, keep the sighting with its plant, and build a history you can come back to. Plant specialists join Nabta to review growers' cases.

plant.title: Add your plants
plant.body: Give each plant a profile with its name, type and where it grows.

photo.title: Photograph what you find
photo.body: Get close, keep it sharp, and add the date and a note. The photo stays with its plant.

history.title: Come back to its history
history.body: Every sighting sits on the plant's page, newest first, so changes are easy to spot.

landing.growerBody: Home gardeners and nursery staff keep a record of every insect they find, plant by plant, with photos, dates and notes.
landing.specialistBody: Pest specialists get a review queue for the cases growers send, with the photo, the plant and the grower's notes in one place.
landing.footer: Nabta is an SE499 senior project supervised by Dr. Suad Alramouni.
